key_insight: HorizON jointly learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories to predict organic battery behavior beyond single-cycle targets.
engineering_relevance: Modeling the full battery stack and usage conditions could support long-term performance prediction, inverse design, and process optimization.
method: Extend a data-fusion, multi-task framework to multi-horizon prediction.
Use a multi-fidelity Deep Operator Network to learn redox potentials and capacity trajectories jointly.
Train on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions to capture component interactions.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes training on DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent capacity trajectories but reports no dataset sizes, accuracy metrics, or validation results.
watch_item: Generalization to unseen stack chemistries and cycling conditions remains unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
